shortDescription: OpenDrSai desktop shell for the DrSai AI assistant.
description: OpenDrSai is a Windows desktop shell for the DrSai AI assistant. It provides local backend install and repair workflows, chat, workspace context, files, terminal, and AI agent tools.
certificationNotes: This app can read user-selected workspace files and send prompts or selected context to configured AI services.
The release build must be Authenticode signed and uploaded from the immutable versioned GitHub Release URL.
If reviewers need a test account or API key, provide it in the private Partner Center notes before submission.
Do not claim medical diagnosis, emergency support, or clinical decision making in Store metadata.

screenshotRequirements.name: chat-workspace
screenshotRequirements.description: Main chat workspace with composer, sidebar, and files panel.

screenshotRequirements.name: settings
screenshotRequirements.description: Settings page showing account/backend configuration without secrets.

dataSafetySummary.localFiles: Reads only user-selected workspace files and app logs.
dataSafetySummary.promptsAndConversations: May send user prompts and selected context to configured AI services.
dataSafetySummary.credentials: Stores local configuration such as API keys using app-controlled settings; do not expose secrets in screenshots.
dataSafetySummary.network: Uses HTTPS for update checks, release downloads, authentication, and AI service requests.
